data_status: STRICT MODE: this dataset contains only values that were compared with, or ingested directly from, retrieved sources: JPL (SSD, SBDB), NASA (NSSDC fact sheets and mission catalog, Small Spacecraft SoA report 2026, SLS page, Apollo 11 press kit, NTRS papers, ), ULA, ESA, NIST, and the Launch Library 2 aggregator. Records carry source_authority/confidence where the source is an aggregator or vendor-reported compilation. Recalled, estimated and fictional values (optimizer catalog, costs, engine/vehicle specs without a retrievable source, the user-supplied SpaceX table) are not included. Derived values are computed only from verified inputs and are labelled derived.

record.spec_note: mass/power fields are taken from the first sentence in the NASA description that states a mass in kg or a power in W; they may describe a sub-unit or a mode. Read the sentence.
record.name: Interdisciplinary Scientist
record.description: Surface profile, roughness, and electrical properties data from the Pioneer Venus radar altimeter were analyzed in conjunction with spacecraft-derived gravity information and earth-based radar backscatter data to produce a series of cartographic and geologic maps. The initial maps included geometric arrays of radar profiles and topographic contour data. These were then utilized to produce a shaded relief cartographic map, scale 1 to 25 million, with superimposed contour information. Preliminary Venusian geologic information, inferred from all available spacecraft and earth-based radar data sources, will subsequently be added to the cartographic map base to produce geologic maps. It is anticipated that one to three larger-scale (1 to 5.E6) cartographic and geologic maps of scientifically interesting Venusian surface features also will be produced.
